segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Priya. Can I get your company name and the last four digits of the account ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, it’s Northline Parts, account ending 4418. I’m calling about reducing our seats from 42 to 35 before the September 1 renewal.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m pulling that up in the billing tool now. Okay, I see your workspace and the current annual plan. You want 35 seats starting September 1, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. The issue is Marcus in billing told me by email yesterday that seat reductions only apply at renewal, but Jenna on chat this morning said you can process it immediately and issue a prorated credit. Those can’t both be right, so I need the straight answer before I send this to finance.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I understand. Let me check the account notes and the policy in the knowledge base so I’m not guessing here.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for holding. For annual subscriptions, seat reductions take effect at the next renewal. So for you, September 1. We can remove the unused users from access now, but the billing change and the lower seat count start on the renewal invoice. No prorated credit for the current term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: All right, that’s what I needed. Can you set it to 35 for September 1 and send me something in writing?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I’m entering the scheduled change now. Your renewal estimate will show 35 seats at $28 per seat per month, billed annually, so $11,760 before taxes. The ticket number is 287614.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send that to billing@northlineparts.com and copy me, danielle.ross@northlineparts.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. You should have the confirmation in a minute or two. Anything else on the account today?
